description: Current AI alignment techniques like RLHF do not scale to superhuman AI systems because they rely on human supervision that becomes impossible as AI capabilities exceed human expertise.

instances.assertion: Current AI alignment techniques like RLHF do not scale to superhuman AI systems because they rely on human supervision that becomes impossible as AI capabilities exceed human expertise.
Current AI alignment research faces significant challenges in specifying the full range of human alignment goals.
Current AI alignment techniques frequently fail in frontier models, meaning they do not provide a strong guarantee of safety.
